name: flaky-async-test-stabilize-p1
prompt: how do I fix tests that pass locally but fail randomly in CI

chunks.content: the worst offenders used a fixed sleep waiting for an async result; replacing each sleep with a poll-until-condition with a timeout removed the timing races
the cache warmer now runs on deploy so the first users do not eat a cold start
the integration suite has been red about one run in five this week and it is eroding trust in the pipeline
scheduled a weekly vacuum analyze on the largest tables
updated the contributor guide with how to run the suite locally
the export-to-pdf feature is behind a toggle while we finish the layout
each test gets a fresh transactional database that rolls back at teardown
froze the system clock in date-sensitive tests so a midnight boundary no longer flips an assertion
two tests were sharing a module-level cache, so order made them flap; giving each test its own instance and resetting globals between runs stopped the intermittent CI-only failures
added a lint rule banning bare except clauses
the load test drove 2000 requests per second and the p99 stayed under 200ms, so the autoscaler config is validated
the payment gateway is mocked in tests so we never hit the real sandbox during a run
parametrized the currency formatter test across twelve locales to catch rounding edge cases
discovered one suite seeded the RNG from the clock; pinning a fixed seed made the shuffle-order failures reproducible and then fixable
snapshot tests for the email HTML are regenerated whenever the template intentionally changes
raised the coverage gate to 85 percent and added cases for the previously untested refund path
